strengths.text: It owns a moderated patient community with a long history, which gives it a peer-support asset that is not rented from a social platform.
It has built an audio and publishing line beyond the newsroom: an innovation podcast made with a public-media partner and a consumer podcast portfolio under Mayo Clinic Press.
Its YouTube channel reached the 1 million subscriber mark in 2023, a scale it announced itself.
Brand advertising is developed in-house and bought nationally plus in local markets in Minnesota, Arizona and Florida, and it publicizes its U.S. News standing through its own newsroom.

gaps.text: TikTok is not among the "Follow Mayo Clinic" links in the mayoclinic.org footer as opened on 2026-11-10, although the organization has posted there since January 2024.
By its own account Mayo Clinic started posting on TikTok in January 2024, more than three years after Cleveland Clinic's newsroom was already referring to its TikTok channel.

opportunitiesForUpmc.text: A hosted, moderated condition community is a differentiator few systems have; UPMC could test one around a small number of service lines before committing to a full platform.
Mayo Clinic separates an innovation show for a general audience from practical wellness shows; UPMC could decide which of those two audiences a podcast is for before producing one.
Mayo Clinic's app bundles daily health content with appointments and results; UPMC could review whether its own patient app gives people a reason to open it between visits.
